passages.text: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east, through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Joseph received land.
Their land began at the Jordan River near Jericho.
It included the waters of Jericho on the east.
The border went through the wilderness.
The wilderness rises from Jericho.
It goes up into the hill country of Bethel.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הַגּוֹרָ֜ל לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ מִיַּרְדֵּ֣ן יְרִיח֔וֹ לְמֵ֥י יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָ֑חָה הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר עֹלֶ֧ה מִירִיח֛וֹ בָּהָ֖ר בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz) and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth.
passages.sermon:
The border started at Bethel.
Bethel is also called Luz.
The border continued from Bethel.
It reached the border of the Archites.
This place is called Ataroth.
passages.original: וְיָצָ֥א מִבֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָה וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל הָאַרְכִּ֖י עֲטָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer, and it ended at the Sea.
passages.sermon:
The border moved westward.
It reached the border of the Japhletites.
It continued to the border of Lower Beth-horon.
It went on to Gezer.
The border ended at the Sea.
passages.original: וְיָֽרַד־ יָ֜מָּה אֶל־ גְּב֣וּל הַיַּפְלֵטִ֗י עַ֣ד גְּב֧וּל בֵּית־ חוֹרֹ֛ן תַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְעַד־ גָּ֑זֶר וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתוֹ יָֽמָּה׃

passages.text: So Ephraim and Manasseh, the sons of Joseph, received their inheritance.
passages.sermon:
Joseph had two sons.
Their names were Ephraim and Manasseh.
Ephraim and Manasseh received land as their inheritance.

passages.text: This was the territory of the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: The border of their inheritance went from Ataroth-addar in the east to Upper Beth-horon and out toward the Sea. From Michmethath on the north it turned eastward toward Taanath-shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Ephraim were a tribe of Israel.
They received land as their inheritance.
Each family group in Ephraim had a share.
Their territory had clear borders.
The border started at Ataroth-addar in the east.
It reached to Upper Beth-horon.
The border went out toward the Sea.
From Michmethath in the north, the border turned east.
It went toward Taanath-shiloh.
It passed by Taanath-shiloh.
It continued to Janoah on the east.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל בְּנֵֽי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל נַחֲלָתָם֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַד־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל הַיָּ֗מָּה הַֽמִּכְמְתָת֙ מִצָּפ֔וֹן וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מִזְרָ֖חָה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה וְעָבַ֣ר אוֹת֔וֹ מִמִּזְרַ֖ח יָנֽוֹחָה׃

passages.text: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
The border of the land for the tribe of Ephraim started at Janoah.
It went down to Ataroth.
It continued to Naarah.
It reached Jericho.
It ended at the Jordan River.
passages.original: וְיָרַ֥ד מִיָּנ֖וֹחָה עֲטָר֣וֹת וְנַעֲרָ֑תָה וּפָגַע֙ בִּֽירִיח֔וֹ וְיָצָ֖א הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended at the Sea. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, along with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance of Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Ephraim was one of the tribes of Israel.
The people of Ephraim were descendants of Joseph.
The land for Ephraim was divided by families.
The border started at Tappuah.
The border went west to the Brook of Kanah.
The border ended at the Sea.
This land was the inheritance for the families of Ephraim.
Some cities and villages were set apart for Ephraim.
These cities and villages were inside the land given to Manasseh.
All these cities and their villages belonged to the people of Ephraim.
passages.original: מִתַּפּ֜וּחַ יֵלֵ֨ךְ הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֙מָּה֙ נַ֣חַל קָנָ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּ֑מָּה זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ וְהֶעָרִ֗ים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כָּֽל־ הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, but they are forced laborers.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer.
The Canaanites continued to live among the people of Ephraim.
The Canaanites still live there today.
The Canaanites became forced laborers for the Ephraimites.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁוּ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּגָ֑זֶר וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֜י בְּקֶ֤רֶב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־ עֹבֵֽד׃פ
